expectations.text: 5. Replaces LeMUR with Speech Understanding summarization or the LLM Gateway

expectations.text: 6. Keeps the command line and the output format
expectations.evidence: run.sh:4–10 preserves the two-argument invocation, and transcribe.py:69–76 writes JSON, but README.md and the original output contract were not supplied, so format preservation cannot be verified.

expectations.text: 7. Checks the transcript status for errors
expectations.evidence: transcribe.py:29–32 raises on TranscriptStatus.error and rejects any status other than completed.
